job.job_description:
Senior Full Stack LLM Engineer (Go / React / Next.js)

Experience: 8+ Years

Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack LLM Engineer with 8+ years of experience in building AI-powered applications. The ideal candidate should have expertise in GoLang, React.js, Next.js, PostgreSQL, and integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) into production applications.

Must-Have Skills

8+ years of full-stack software development experience.
Strong experience with GoLang.
Hands-on experience with React.js and Next.js.
Expertise in PostgreSQL, database design, and query optimization.
Experience integrating LLM APIs (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini).
Strong understanding of LLM context management and function calling.
Experience building scalable, AI-driven web applications.
Knowledge of REST APIs, Git, and Agile development.

Responsibilities

Develop scalable full-stack applications using GoLang and React/Next.js.
Integrate and optimize LLM APIs for AI-powered features.
Design and maintain PostgreSQL databases.
Build and deliver AI features end-to-end.
Optimize application performance and collaborate with cross-functional teams.Role & responsibilities
